feature: Letter RR3/DR3 dilewati untuk kendaraan Military/Diplomatic (PS-MID/PS-DIP) dan TS-CLV otomatis untuk kendaraan VIP setelah surat RR3/DR3
note: Di stage RR3/DR3 kendaraan tipe I (Military) dan D (Diplomatic) dikeluarkan dari file Toppan dan diberi PS-MID/PS-DIP; kendaraan VIP tetap dapat surat lalu diberi TS-CLV setelah stage diperbarui. Dipakai surat ke-3 hirer (OCMS12.31) tetapi tidak disebut di teks lima story chunk ini; mungkin dicakup story OCMS17 atau Epic lain, perlu dicek oleh yang menyusun orphans.
note_en: At stage RR3/DR3, vehicles of type I (Military) and D (Diplomatic) are removed from the Toppan file and given PS-MID/PS-DIP; VIP vehicles still get the letter and then TS-CLV after the stage is updated. Used by the hirer 3rd letter (OCMS12.31) but not named in the text of the five stories in this chunk; may be covered by an OCMS17 story or another epic, to be checked by whoever merges the orphans.

feature: Administration fee otomatis pada stage RR3/DR3 (parameter ADM): amount_payable = composition_amount + administration_fee, dan fee dinolkan di stage lain
note: Saat stage RR3/DR3 diproses, administration_fee diambil dari ocms_parameter (ADM) lalu ditambahkan ke amount_payable; di stage lain fee ditulis 0 (OCMS-DF-2026-170, Closed). Terkait surat ke-3 hirer (OCMS12.31) tetapi tidak disebut di teks story chunk ini; nilai ADM di DB cannot verify from repo.
note_en: When stage RR3/DR3 is processed, administration_fee is read from ocms_parameter (ADM) and added to amount_payable; at other stages the fee is written as 0 (OCMS-DF-2026-170, Closed). Related to the hirer 3rd letter (OCMS12.31) but not named in the text of the stories in this chunk; the ADM value in the DB cannot verify from repo.
